FeatureDocuments: Create and edit documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and PDF forms right in your browser.
FeatureOrganize: Find anything in seconds with search, filters, favorites, and the list of recent files.
FeatureSecurity: Flexible access rights protect your files, and deleted items can be restored from Trash.
FeatureSharing: Grant access to your files and co-edit documents with others in real time.
TourActions: Use the quick action tiles to create new documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and PDF forms in one click.
TourInfoPanel: Open the info panel to view file details, manage sharing, and track the history of changes.
TourMyDocuments: This is your personal space. Files stored here are visible only to you until you share them.
TourQuickAccess: Files shared with you, recent documents, favorites, and Trash are always at hand right under Files.
TourSearch: Find the file you need in seconds: search by name or apply filters by type and author.
TourView: Switch between the row and tile views — choose whichever is more convenient for you.
